q: Why did I receive less than my expected settlement amount?
ref: Net settlement equals gross captured amount minus platform fees, GST on fees, refunds issued in the period and dispute holds.

q: When will my settlement arrive?
ref: Standard settlement cycle is T+2 working days, skipping weekends and holidays, plus up to 4 hours for bank credit.

q: How do I issue a refund?
ref: Call POST /v1/payments/{id}/refund with an optional amount and speed; only captured payments can be refunded.

q: What documents are required for merchant verification of a company?
ref: Company PAN, certificate of incorporation, GST certificate, director PAN and Aadhaar, board resolution and bank proof in company name.

q: Which API should I use for recurring payments?
ref: Use the Subscriptions API with a plan_id for fixed schedules, or the Mandates API for variable amounts.

q: Customer was debited but my order shows failed
ref: The payment is likely captured but the payment.captured webhook was not processed; fetch the payment to verify.

q: What does PAY_ERR_3DS_FAILED mean?
ref: 3-D Secure OTP authentication failed or timed out; the customer must retry and complete the OTP within 5 minutes.

q: I get 401 AUTH_INVALID_KEY
ref: The key_id does not exist or a test key was used against live data or vice versa.

q: How long do I have to respond to a chargeback?
ref: 7 calendar days to submit evidence; missing the deadline is an automatic loss.

q: Refund has not reached the customer, what should I check?
ref: Fetch the refund; if processed share the ARN with the customer; card refunds take 5-7 working days.

q: What is the platform fee and GST?
ref: 2% platform fee on cards, UPI and wallets plus 18% GST charged on the fee.

q: My webhook signature does not match
ref: Verify HMAC-SHA256 on the raw request body with the webhook secret, not a re-serialised body.

q: Payment authorized but not captured after several days
ref: With manual capture an authorized payment is voided after 5 days unless captured.

q: How does idempotency work on POST requests?
ref: Send an Idempotency-Key header; repeats within 24 hours return the original response.

q: How fast are UPI refunds?
ref: UPI refunds arrive in 1-3 working days.

q: What is the rate limit for the API?
ref: Live mode allows 1000 requests per minute; exceeding returns 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

q: UPI_TIMEOUT
ref: The customer did not approve the UPI collect request within 5 minutes.

q: AUTH_IP_NOT_ALLOWED
ref: An IP allow-list is configured and the server IP is not on it.

q: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
ref: The same Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request body.

q: the buyer says the money never came back
ref: Check the refund status, share the ARN and allow 5-7 working days for cards.

q: why is my payout smaller than what my customers paid
ref: Fees, GST and refunds are deducted from the gross captured amount.

q: my monthly plan stopped billing after a card failure
ref: Failed renewals are retried on days 1, 3 and 5, then the subscription is halted.

q: how much extra does instant refund cost
ref: speed optimum costs an extra 0.3% of the refund amount.

q: GET /v1/settlements/reconciliation
ref: Returns a per-payment breakdown for a settlement or date range.

q: can I test webhooks from my laptop
ref: RagPay does not deliver to localhost; use an HTTPS tunnel.
